prompt: If Alice turned 36 on the day John F. Kennedy was assassinated, how old would she be on the day the Berlin Wall fell?
answer:
Alice would be **61 years old** when the Berlin Wall fell on November 9, 1989.

She turned 36 on November 22, 1963, so she was born November 22, 1927. Since November 9, 1989, was before her birthday, she had not yet turned 62.
